recipe.visualDefinition: A high-contrast, gritty urban composition featuring two male portraits integrated into large-scale, semi-transparent typography. The color palette is dominated by warm sepia and burnt orange tones against a dark, textured background, creating a sense of street-level drama and intensity.
coreVisualRelationships: Large-scale display type acts as a window/mask for the primary portraits.
Warm sepia skin tones contrast against a dark, mottled charcoal background.
Vertical alignment of text blocks creates a structured, architectural frame around the central imagery.
coreInvariants: Heavy film grain and gritty texture across the entire canvas.
Extreme vertical compression of all display typography.
Monochromatic sepia-to-black color grading for the photographic elements.

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: Two close-up portraits occupy the center, one looking directly at the viewer and one in profile, scaled to fill the vertical height of the central lettering.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The large, semi-transparent central word that spans the entire height of the frame.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: Starts at the top-left text block, moves down through the central portraits, and finishes at the bottom-right title and credits.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Minimal; the composition is densely packed with texture and information, using dark edges to contain the central glow.

colorSystem.dominantColorRole: Burnt orange and sepia (mid-tones and highlights of the portraits).
colorSystem.contrastColorRole: Deep charcoal and black (background and shadows).
colorSystem.accentColorRole: Pure white (used for secondary and tertiary text to ensure legibility).
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: High value contrast with low color saturation, focusing on the warmth of the orange hues.
paletteRestrictions: Limit to sepia, black, and white

characterSpecificRedesigns: Central display type uses a transparency effect to reveal the image behind it while maintaining a distinct outline or color shift.
typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: Varying widths of the same sans-serif family to create hierarchy through scale and compression.

candidateDirections.reason: Provides the necessary vertical weight and condensed structure.
Offers the extreme narrowness required for the display roles.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Create a gritty, dark charcoal textured background. In the center, place two male portraits in a warm sepia tone. One portrait should be a front-facing expressive face, the other a profile view. Apply heavy film grain and a subtle orange glow to the faces.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Apply ultra-condensed uppercase sans-serif text in the top-left and bottom-right corners in solid white. Add a very large, semi-transparent word across the center that masks the portraits. Add a single line of wide-tracked small text across the lower third.

verificationChecks: Is the central text semi-transparent and revealing the portraits?
Is the color palette strictly sepia, black, and white?
Is the typography extremely vertically condensed?
Is there a consistent gritty texture across the whole image?

adjustableVariables: Transparency percentage of the central text mask
Vertical stretch ratio of the typography
mustRedesign: Any specific logos or branding marks
The exact wording of the credits and titles
The specific faces of the individuals
postGenerationChecks: Ensure text does not obscure vital facial features like eyes.
Check that the white text is legible against the sepia background.
Verify that the grain doesn't look like digital artifacts but like film stock.
Confirm the composition feels balanced despite the heavy text.
recipe.reuseFormula: Combine high-contrast sepia portraiture with ultra-condensed sans-serif typography using transparency masks to integrate the two layers into a single gritty, urban-themed graphic.
